title: HTML parsing insertion via insertAdjacentHTML (javascript) — review required
description: The javascript call insertAdjacentHTML parses its string argument as markup and inserts the result into the document, so any attacker-influenced character becomes live DOM. When the value is text rather than markup, use textContent. This lexical rule flags the call; it does not trace the argument.
remediation: Insert untrusted text with textContent, or sanitize markup with a maintained sanitizer before insertion.
limitation: Lexical, line-based: matches the insertAdjacentHTML call; the argument’s provenance is out of scope.
